rec.name: PDP Product Tabs (Tabs on Desktop, Accordion on Mobile)
rec.status: Built — delivered, documented (Slite doc); product image still requested for docs

what.text: A theme-agnostic Shopify section, "CRO | Product Tabs", that shows product information in a horizontal tab bar on desktop (uppercase labels, animated underline on the active tab, thin divider line, first tab open by default). On mobile the same blocks turn into a collapsible accordion. Each block is one tab and can be a Description (pulls product.description), a free Content block (rich text or a linked Page), a Custom Liquid/HTML block, or an FAQ block (up to 12 question/answer pairs, each with an 'open by default' toggle). Tables can be placed inside tab content via the HTML field. It replicates the tab function of the Focal theme but works in any theme.

why.text: Product pages carry a lot of secondary information (description, shipping, materials, size tables, FAQs). Tabs and accordions keep the page short and scannable while leaving the details one click away. This lowers cognitive load and scrolling, answers purchase objections (FAQs, size tables, care and shipping info) near the buy box and supports trust and risk reduction. Opening the first tab by default guarantees core information is visible without interaction, and collapsing on mobile avoids long page scrolls.

how.text: Create the section file ed-cro-product-tabs.liquid and paste in the provided code (CSS, Liquid and a small vanilla-JS tab controller, with no Focal code dependencies). In the theme editor, add the section to the product template and add blocks (Description, FAQ, Content, Custom Liquid), reordering them as needed. Each block's title becomes the tab label on desktop and the accordion header on mobile. Desktop tabs are driven by JS: click switches the active class, animates content height and slides the underline indicator; the first tab is initialised as active. Mobile uses custom <ed-collapsible> accordion markup (a button with aria-expanded plus a collapsible content div). The JS re-initialises on Shopify section load events so it works in the theme editor. Per-product content is intended via metafields or page assignments (e.g. Liquid/Content blocks that reference product metafields or Pages).

items: Custom max-width toggle plus max-width slider (preview shows 930px)
Section spacing desktop: top, bottom, left, right (px)
Section spacing mobile: top, bottom, left, right (px)
Blocks: Description, FAQ, Content, Custom Liquid (add, remove, reorder; number of tabs is flexible, ~4 recommended)
Per block: title, optional linked Page, rich-text content, 'expanded by default' (mobile)
FAQ block: up to 12 question/answer pairs, each with an open-by-default toggle

dependencies.text: Works with any Shopify theme, but the code assumes a few Focal-style theme conventions: the translation key 'product.general.description', the global theme settings settings.heading_color, settings.text_color and settings.background, the CSS variable --container-gutter and the .heading--small class. It needs checking or adapting on non-Focal themes. Per-product maintainability (the PL team's wish for self-created metafields) needs custom product metafields or page assignments referenced in blocks. The ticket requested separate line colour, icons per tab, a dedicated table builder and FAQ assignment, but these are not in the delivered code and settings screenshot: divider colour is hard-coded (#dfdfdf), there are no icon settings and tables are only styled through the HTML field.

items: Tab click-through / accordion open rate per tab
Scroll depth and time on PDP
Customer-service contacts about shipping, size or product info

images.caption: Theme editor: 'CRO | Product Tabs' section with Description, FAQ, Content and Custom Liquid blocks, the settings panel (width, max-width, colours, desktop/mobile spacing) and the live desktop preview with the tab bar (BESCHREIBUNG / FAQ'S / TITLE 1 / TITLE) and the active underline.
